brief: critic with fresh context on W1-FACTIONS (RI-QST01 faction escalation shape, RI-QST02, RI-CRM02)
findings: ARBITRATION #1 ROOT CAUSE (static, browser confirmation pending): tools/analysis/build-viability.mjs:1191 does `c.reputation = new Proxy({}, { get: () => 100 })`. The counterfactual grants gold=1e9, ranks=7, all topics and all world flags, but pins EVERY faction reputation at the literal 100. faction-gates.json rank 7 now demands min_reputation 112 (it was 100 under the old generated ladder). So the 0/540 build-viability figure is the TOOL`s own stub constant colliding with the new ladder, not a real ceiling. Line 1599 of the same file even quotes the stop verbatim: the_imperial_assize reputation 100/112.

INDEPENDENT RE-DERIVATION (critic tool scratchpad/rep-ceiling.mjs, static over game/data/quests/**): summing the BEST own-faction reputation delta per quest in rank order, the player holds 249 (Assize), 208 (Ledger), 228 (Xul-Aneekh) at the moment the rank-7 quest is checked against a demand of 112. Attainable end-of-line totals 341 / 298 / 318. Reputation 112 is reached around quest 5 of 9 on every line. The builder is right; the tool builder is wrong.

LINE LENGTHS ARE 9/9/10, NOT 8/9/8: the three carried files hold 9+8+8=25 quests, but Q-LEDG-01 (blackmarsh-core.json), Q-DEEP-01 and Q-MAG-10 are pre-existing quests already tagged to these factions. Census by faction: the_imperial_assize 10, the_wet_ledger 9, the_xul_aneekh 9. Q-XULA-02 does not exist anywhere - the Xul-Aneekh line has a hole at rank 2 filled by Q-DEEP-01.

faction-gates.json is now 8 factions (the ixtu_vakh/the_ixtu_vakh duplicate is resolved). Rank-7 min_reputation is 112 for ALL EIGHT - the rep column is still globally identical across factions; only the attribute column varies (Assize 4-8, Drowned Court 9-12, Wet Ledger 8-12, the other five identical 8-11).

RI-QST01 SECOND HARD FAIL, NOT IN THE BUILDER`S ADMISSIONS: "Mean quests per rank < 2.0 -> fail" is an explicit hard fail in RI-QST01 Scoring. Measured 1.25 (Assize, 10 quests), 1.125 (Ledger, 9), 1.125 (Xul-Aneekh, 9) against 3.0 target. The builder declared the 9-vs-24-28 volume gap but not this one, and they are separate gates. Also 0 hidden/weird quests on any line (Table B asks +2 each, discovery: found/overheard).

RI-QST02 D6 IS A HARD FAIL GAME-WIDE AND ITS OWN METHOD CANNOT SEE IT: kill_required_npcs is EMPTY on all 94 quests, so the item`s Comparison method #4 (jq select kill_required_npcs length > 0) returns the empty set and D6 passes vacuously - a probe that cannot fail. Under D6`s prose definition ("or a combat resolution against a named NPC") 7 of 25 = 28% carry a talk_to_target reveal, against a <30% HARD FAIL floor. 18 failures, all Q-MAG-* plus Q-XULA-01 res_kill_the_crew, which is inside the line under judgement and is that quest`s HIGHEST-reputation resolution (+28).

RI-QST02 HARD FAIL, pre-existing but one instance sits in the Assize census: 12 quests have deceit != null and ZERO reveal with before_point_of_no_return (Q-MAG-02/04/05/06/07/10/13/16/18/19/24, Q-MAIN-32). Q-MAG-10 is category=faction, faction=the_imperial_assize - its deceit block has no patterns[] at all and one reveal with no before_point_of_no_return flag. Q-MAIN-27 has deceit with a single resolution (the other listed hard fail).

TOPICS ARE REAL - THE 74-OF-76 DEFECT HAS NOT RECURRED. 404 topic ids on disk, 0 with an empty body, 0 dangling topic->topic links tree-wide. 50-factions.json ships 31 topics, median 3 infos and 485 characters each, every one with outbound links. Exactly ONE quest opens_by topic on the three lines has no body: Q-MAG-10 "the witness" (pre-existing). NOTE: my first extractor read responses/entries/variants and reported all 31 as empty - the bodies are under infos[].x. False positive corrected before it reached the verdict.

RI-CRM02 §8: shipped exclusivity is 5 hard pairs (1 hard_group + 1 enemy_pair + 3 earned) against a target of >=8 (hard fail <4). The ku-vastei, Morag Tong, Sap-Cutter and rootkeeper-service rows of RI-CRM02 §4 have no representation at all. Sanctioned murder: exactly ONE writ quest in the tree (Q-ASSZ-05, Warrant of Attainder) against a target of 27 (hard fail <15) -> RI-CRM02 HARD FAIL. Expulsion: the string appears in one quest (Q-XULA-04) and machine.js; there is no expulsion data file and no readmission path (RI-QST03 §D).

faction-probe.mjs P9 ("walked entirely non-violently") measures the resolutions THE PROBE CHOSE, and the chooser adds +10000 cost to any violent resolution (line 187) and then BUYS the skills, attributes and reveals the chosen resolution needs (lines 194-207). So "0 of 16/17/16 resolutions needing violence" is not a property of the data - 5 faction-line resolutions do carry violence_required: true (Q-ASSZ-05 res_execute, Q-LEDG-07 res_kill_her, Q-XULA-01 res_kill_the_crew, Q-XULA-06 res_stand_on_the_tracks, Q-XULA-07 res_the_gallery_way). The honest claim is "every quest has at least one non-violent resolution", which IS true and is worth having.

D3 dissenter test PASSES on all three lines and is the best thing in the piece: notary-sedda-vell on 6 Assize quests with requires_knowing citing her on 5; npc-wuleen-kus on 5 Ledger quests, cited on 4; ee-vashum on 3 Xul-Aneekh quests, cited on 3. Real Percius Mercius analogues that unlock branches, not notes in a chest.
Journal records_belief is 63/752 = 8.4% against a >=15% target (hard fail <5%). 0 imperative journal openings tree-wide (AR-2 regex clean).

ARBITRATION #1 SETTLED IN THE RUNNING ENGINE. reports/critic-faction-arbitration.json: driving the_wet_ledger reputation across 0..300 with membership set, the Q-LEDG-08 offer row s gate.unmet contains "The Wet Ledger reputation 111/112" at rep 111 and DROPS the reputation term entirely at rep 112. Same on Q-ASSZ-08 and Q-XULA-08. Reputation 112 is attainable and the shipped gate reads it. THE FACTION BUILDER IS RIGHT. build-viability.mjs is wrong for a reason its own source names at line 1191: c.reputation = new Proxy({}, {get: () => 100}) - a literal left over from the OLD generated ladder whose rank 7 was 100. Its 0/540 is the tool colliding with its own stub constant.

gate.js evaluate() takes the BEST of the two favoured attributes (sort desc, [0]) and the TOP TWO of the six favoured skills - faithful to Morrowind, and it means a critic computing min() over favoured attributes measures nothing. I made that mistake in my first pass and corrected it.

THE RANK-7 SEAT WAS NEVER VACATED BY PLAY. All three faction-probe reports on disk end their P10 string with "(the probe poked in <assize_prefect_vacant|ledger_first_chair_vacant|deepkin_speaker_vacant> to clear rank world_state terms)". The rank-5 and rank-6 world_state flags ARE raised by the walk; the rank-7 one never is, because the walk prefers the cheapest non-violent ending and on all three lines that is the REFUSE ending, which is precisely the ending that does not vacate the seat (Q-ASSZ-07 res_refuse_hulen, Q-LEDG-07 res_refuse, Q-XULA-07 res_tell_the_hollow). P4 "rank 7, never set" and P9 "walked without killing" are individually true and jointly untested. Measured: reports/critic-faction-ceiling.json.

SINGLE BIGGEST GAP - THE OFFER GATE IS ENFORCED AT open() AND NOT AT resolve(). reports/critic-faction-gate-bypass.json, with a passing control. On a character that has joined nothing and holds reputation 0, questOpen(Q-LEDG-07) is refused out loud ("the_wet_ledger rank 0/6; the_wet_ledger reputation 0/90") and questResolve returns {ok:false,"quest not open"}. One questReveal() call later the SAME questResolve returns ok:true and applies the full consequence set: world_flags [ledger_first_chair_settled, ledger_first_chair_vacant, corrano_took_it_to_the_assize, ledger_exposed_from_inside], unlocked [Q-LEDG-08], faction_reputation to four factions including +40 to the RIVAL Assize, and NPC dispositions. Cause: machine.js reveal() calls this.rec(id, true) which CREATES the record that resolve() line 465 tests for. machine.js:541 guards the journal branch with this.rec(h.quest) and machine.js:540 does not guard the reveal branch immediately above it.

BLAST RADIUS of the bypass: today 0 of 110 hooks.json rows carry a quest+reveal pair, so the world-side path at machine.js:540 (setFlag -> reveal -> rec(create)) is LATENT rather than live - it becomes player-reachable the moment any hook adds a reveal, which the schema permits and the code already reads. It is however live for MEASUREMENT right now: faction-probe.mjs:207 calls H.questReveal for every requires_knowing before H.questResolve at line 210, and its questOpen calls at lines 246/294 ignore the return value. Every resolution in every faction-probe walk was applied outside the offer gate.

harness questDef() exposes NO resolutions and NO consequences (api.js:1514-1529). questResolutionRequirements() covers the requires half only. So which ending changes the world is invisible from inside the running build - which is why the builder had to poke the flag rather than pick a vacating ending. This is the trimmed-view defect only half repaired.
